changes.title: Readable on any phone, with tap to call.
changes.text: Today every page opens as a shrunken desktop page and 713-462-3616 is plain text. The concept puts a call button at the top of every screen.

changes.title: A real quote request.
changes.text: Right now a quote is one choice in a dropdown on the Contact page. The concept leads with a short request for material, quantity and due date, with room to attach a drawing.

changes.title: Your work and equipment up front.
changes.text: Your parts gallery, EDM capability and Mori Seiki, Mitsubishi and Brother machines sit on inner pages today. The concept shows them on the homepage.
